rehearsal.label: MISSION REHEARSAL (one planned cell; not the random-cell Site23 final exam)

meta.source: plan plan_001.json (exact Navigator ranking (forced); light NASA SPICE DE440 + exact skyline; terrain NASA LOLA; ice goals: NASA LOLA PSR ed); terrain NASA LOLA 5 m lola5m_site23; lander physics worldmodel.lander.env

notes: Every mission targets the plan's cell; start offset, velocity, failures and sensor noise are random (seeded) and identical for both pilots.
Touchdown truth = official LOLA slope rule; the pilot's camera sees the slope-rule backup belief from the sparse laser pixels.
Lighting/time of landing does not enter the lander simulation; the plan's landing time is carried for reference only.
Site23 is this pilot's final-exam site: this rehearsal flies ONE cell there and does not replace the random-cell final exam.

procedural.label: PROCEDURAL MAPS - GENERATED — NOT OBSERVED

meta.source: worldmodel.lander.mission_bench procedural crater maps (data_tools.make_demo_tile generator, made realistic as described); laser masks borrowed from NASA LOLA tiles; lander physics worldmodel.lander.env

notes: GENERATED — NOT OBSERVED: synthetic terrain; never used alone for a safety claim.
Craters evaluated only within 2.5 radii of their centre (same output as make_demo_tile, checked above).

Per map: 500-2500 craters, regional tilt 0-7 deg (random azimuth), real LOLA laser-coverage mask (pilot training tiles, rotated) so the camera's backup belief is gap-filled from ~10 % of pixels; truth = gap-free slope >= limit. Targets = random truth-safe cells.
Nothing is written to data/tiles/; the maps exist only in memory and are reproducible from the seeds.
Merged from 5 runs on disjoint map ids (same seeds per map as a serial run); pooled statistics recomputed from the per-map paired counts.
